description: Check whether the locally configured sf executable can return its version. This is offline and does not contact a Salesforce org.
embedding_description: Diagnose whether this host can execute the locally configured Salesforce sf CLI before any network-dependent Salesforce connection check or data operation. The probe resolves the executable and requests only its local version string; it does not inspect credentials, resolve an org alias, or contact Salesforce.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Bounded local verdict containing executable_path, version, and executable.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report this as local CLI availability only; it does not establish that a Salesforce org is configured or reachable.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Check local sf CLI availability without contacting Salesforce.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A false executable result means the configured binary could not successfully report its version.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Install the sf CLI or configure sf_cli_path to an executable local binary, then repeat the probe.
